cases.query: An engineer new to payments asked where our outbound webhook retries are decided and why we settled on those limits. Trace the path from the send call to that decision and point me to the evidence you used.

Twice this week checkout recorded a successful charge and then left the browser spinning. Find a way to make that happen on demand, narrow down the component responsible, and stop once you can show why it happens.

We now have three webhook-retry notes that disagree, plus two incident lessons that overlap. Decide what guidance should survive, show me a consolidation proposal, and wait before changing the knowledge store.
